name: @devdigest/mcp-server
description: Local MCP server exposing DevDigest's review workflow (list agents, run a review, fetch findings/conventions) as 5 stdio MCP tools, talking to server/'s existing Fastify API over localhost HTTP — no in-process server import. Also ships the `devdigest` CLI, which reuses reviewer-core in-process to review the local working tree before push (see src/cli/).
